features.name: Lay on Hands
features.desc: A pool of healing power = 5 × Paladin level. As an action, you touch a creature to restore Hit Points from the pool; for 5 points, you can instead remove a disease or poison. The pool refreshes when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from the Paladin spell list using Charisma (half caster, prepared spells). A Holy Symbol is your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.desc: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons you're proficient with.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.desc: You choose a Fighting Style (Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, etc.).

features.name: Divine Smite
features.desc: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared (see Class Actions). When you expend a spell slot on a melee hit, you deal an extra 2d8 Radiant damage, +1d8 for each slot level above 1 (max 5d8), and another +1d8 against Undead and Fiends.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.desc: You gain uses of Channel Divinity for your oath's techniques. You regain them when you finish a Short or Long Rest (2 uses, 3 at level 11).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.desc: You and allies within 10 feet (30 feet at level 18) gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

grants.note: aura: you and allies within 10 feet add {chaMod} to saving throws

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.desc: As an action, you force creatures you can see within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, their Speed becomes 0 and they have Disadvantage.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.desc: You and allies within 10 feet can't be Frightened.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.desc: Each of your melee hits deals an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.desc: Lay on Hands can also remove conditions: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.desc: The radius of your auras increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.desc: You reach the pinnacle of your oath (the effect depends on your subclass).
